Name: upd_add_graph
SQL:
INSERT INTO tb_graf ( gil, qnumpl, qnumpr )
SELECT qsclera_all.gil, qsclera_all.qnuml, qsclera_all.qnumr
FROM qsclera_all LEFT JOIN tb_graf ON qsclera_all.gil = tb_graf.gil
WHERE (((tb_graf.gil) Is Null));

Name: upd_cust_close
SQL:
UPDATE cust_list SET cust_list.cust_open = False
WHERE (((cust_list.cust_open)=True));

Name: upd_details
SQL:
UPDATE cust_list SET cust_list.address = [Forms]![customers]![address], cust_list.city = [Forms]![customers]![city], cust_list.area = [Forms]![customers]![area], cust_list.tel = [Forms]![customers]![tel], cust_list.sel = [Forms]![customers]![sel], cust_list.khist = [Forms]![customers]![khist]
WHERE (((cust_list.number)=Forms!customers!number And (cust_list.number)<>0) And ((cust_list.numw)<>Forms!customers!numw));

Name: upd_dup_cust
upd_hesh
SQL:
SELECT SAPAKIM.[CODE SAPAK], tb_upd_amount.hesh
FROM (tb_catalog INNER JOIN SAPAKIM ON tb_catalog.sapak=SAPAKIM.[CODE SAPAK]) INNER JOIN tb_upd_amount ON tb_catalog.wnum=tb_upd_amount.rnum;

Name: upd_presence
SQL:
SELECT presence.num, presence.wdate, Trim$(Year(nz([wdate])))+Trim$(Format(Month(nz([wdate])),"00")) AS mm, presence.wtime, presence.wdatee, presence.typ, presence.add_day, presence.short_day, presence.rnum
FROM presence
WHERE (((presence.num)=Forms!Employees!EmployeeID) And ((Trim$(Year(nz([wdate])))+Trim$(Format(Month(nz([wdate])),"00")))>=(Trim$(Year(DateAdd("m",-1,Date())))+Trim$(Format(Month(DateAdd("m",-1,Date())),"00")))))
ORDER BY presence.wdate, presence.wtime;

Name: upd_presence_all
SQL:
SELECT presence.num, presence.wdate, presence.wtime, presence.wdatee, presence.typ, presence.add_day, presence.short_day, presence.rnum
FROM presence
WHERE (((presence.num)=[Forms]![Employees]![EmployeeID]))
ORDER BY presence.wdate, presence.wtime;

Name: upd_swkp
SQL:
UPDATE orders SET orders.swkp = False
WHERE (((orders.numw)=[Forms]![person_orders_list]![numw]));

Name: upd_tb_graph
SQL: UPDATE tb_graf INNER JOIN qsclera_all ON tb_graf.gil=qsclera_all.gil SET tb_graf.qnumpr = [qnumr], tb_graf.qnumpl = [qnuml];

Name: upd_wt
SQL:
SELECT cust_list.hwy AS tl
FROM cust_list
WHERE (((cust_list.hwy) Is Not Null) AND ((IsNumeric([hwy]))=True))
ORDER BY cust_list.hwy DESC;
